papers.title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
papers.abstract: Abstract Two large-scale search agents are trained via a multi-stage pipeline combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning against live search, achieving state-of-the-art open-source results on complex web benchmarks through rigorous trajectory filtering and inference-time context management.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We present Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained at the 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B scales, together with the data pipeline and training recipe behind them. Tasks are reverse-constructed from the hyperlink structure of a web corpus: we author multi-hop chains over an entity graph distilled from a seed page and its out-links, rewrite every non-answer entity into a descriptive reference so that no clue can be resolved by string matching, and admit only questions that a reference model fails closed-book yet solves once the supporting evidence is supplied. These questions are then turned into trajectories, which are filtered at both the trajectory and the turn level before SFT. The policy is then optimized by RL against live search, with the reward judge and the observation summarizer served inside the training cluster, and with over-long rollouts interrupted at the request level and resumed from their committed prefix at the next step. We alternate the two stages in a procedure we call SFT-RL climbing, returning the hardest solved and most efficient rollouts of each RL round to the next supervised pass. Because inference-time context management is worth more on these benchmarks than most reported differences between systems, we evaluate every benchmark both with and without it, holding the tool set, the context limit, and the judge fixed. All results come from a single ReAct agent, with no sub-agents and no test-time verification. With management enabled, on BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, DeepSearchQA, and HLE the two models reach 82.2/84.8/86.9/52.3 and 88.6/85.1/92.9/56.4, the strongest overall results among open-source search agents in their respective parameter ranges. We plan to release the model weights together with the complete recipe for data construction, training, and evaluation.

ru.title: Обучение поисковых агентов через чередующиеся этапы supervised и reinforcement learning
ru.desc: В статье представлены два агента поиска Iris-mini и Iris-pro, обученные с помощью многоэтапного конвейера, который сочетает supervised fine-tuning и reinforcement learning против живого веб-поиска. Задачи были сконструированы путём извлечения многошаговых цепочек из графа сущностей веб-корпуса с строгой фильтрацией траекторий на уровне шагов и ответов. Агенты оптимизируются методом RL с использованием техники SFT-RL climbing, которая чередует этапы обучения с учителем и обучения с подкреплением, возвращая наиболее сложные решённые примеры в следующий supervised проход. Модели достигли state-of-the-art результатов на комплексных бенчмарках веб-поиска благодаря эффективному управлению контекстом во время инференса и отказу от дополнительных агентов и проверки на тестовом наборе.

en.title: Revolutionizing Search with Iris Agents: SFT Meets RL!
en.desc: This paper introduces two advanced search agents, Iris-mini and Iris-pro, which are trained using a combination of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to achieve top performance on complex web search tasks. The training process involves creating multi-hop question chains from a web corpus and filtering trajectories to ensure only the most challenging questions are used for training. The agents are optimized through a unique SFT-RL climbing method, which alternates between supervised and reinforcement learning stages to enhance their performance. The results demonstrate significant improvements in search accuracy, showcasing the effectiveness of context management during inference.

zh.title: 智能搜索代理的突破性进展
zh.desc: 本文介绍了两个大型搜索代理Iris-mini和Iris-pro，它们通过结合监督微调和强化学习的多阶段管道进行训练。这些代理在复杂的网络基准测试中取得了最先进的开源结果，采用了严格的轨迹过滤和推理时上下文管理。任务是从网页语料库的超链接结构反向构建的，确保问题无法通过字符串匹配解决。通过SFT-RL爬升程序交替优化策略，最终实现了在多个基准测试中的最佳表现。

papers.title: Motion-Omni: End-to-End Joint Speech and Full-Body Motion for Spoken Dialogue
papers.abstract: Abstract Motion-Omni is an end-to-end framework that jointly generates spoken dialogue and full-body co-speech motion from shared hidden states, using scalable pseudo-labeling and a unified evaluation protocol to achieve real-time, aligned responses.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small An avatar that holds a conversation should decide what to say and to move while saying it, yet these abilities live in separate model families: spoken dialogue models produce speech without motion, and co-speech motion models produce motion only from audio handed to them. The standard remedy is a cascade that first generates the spoken response and then runs a motion model over the finished audio, which requires a second full inference pass and precludes any joint optimisation between the two. We present Motion-Omni, an end-to-end framework in which a spoken dialogue model natively outputs explicit facial expression together with hand, upper-body and lower-body motion, generated directly from the hidden states that produce the speech. Joint training is not optional here: with the speech pathway frozen, motion remains misaligned with the audio, and co-adapting the LLM, Speech Generator and Motion Generator under both objectives is what recovers alignment while retaining spoken-dialogue ability. Supervision comes from a scalable, model-agnostic pipeline that pseudo-labels consistent-voice speech responses with a replaceable motion teacher, yielding 422,856 quality-ranked pairs (1,402 hours). We further release SwDA-500 and, to our knowledge, the first public evaluation protocol for stochastic open-ended full-body spoken dialogue, matching audio across motion systems while unifying rendering, automatic metrics, human evaluation, and latency measurement. Instantiated with a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone, Motion-Omni-Q7 matches the same-audio teacher cascade to within 2% on reference-free motion metrics while responding 5.4 x faster (RTF=0.78, faster than real time), surpasses all non-teacher cascades on beat correlation and diversity, and reaches a 2.62% word error rate, the lowest among the omni-modal systems compared.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

ru.title: Синхронная генерация речи и жестов в едином конце сети
ru.desc: Motion-Omni — это сквозная архитектура, которая совместно генерирует речевой диалог и полнотелые жесты аватара из общих скрытых представлений, минуя каскадный подход с двумя проходами инференса. Модель объединяет языковую модель, генератор речи и генератор движений в единую систему, обучаемую совместно для согласованности жестов с произносимым текстом. Авторы разработали масштабируемый конвейер псевдо-разметки с использованием учителя движений для создания набора данных из 422,856 пар видео-аудио. Кроме того, предложена первая открытая программа оценки для стохастического полнотелого диалога с унифицированными метриками, человеческой оценкой и измерением задержки.

en.title: Synchronized Speech and Motion for Real-Time Avatars
en.desc: Motion-Omni is a novel framework that integrates spoken dialogue generation with full-body co-speech motion, allowing avatars to produce synchronized speech and movement in real-time. Unlike traditional methods that treat speech and motion generation separately, Motion-Omni uses shared hidden states to create both outputs simultaneously, enhancing alignment and coherence. The framework employs joint training to ensure that the generated motion corresponds accurately to the spoken dialogue, overcoming the limitations of previous cascaded approaches. Additionally, it introduces a scalable pseudo-labeling system and a comprehensive evaluation protocol, achieving significant improvements in response speed and accuracy compared to existing models.

zh.title: 实时对话与动作的完美结合
zh.desc: Motion-Omni是一个端到端的框架，能够同时生成语音对话和全身的配合动作。它通过共享的隐藏状态，使用可扩展的伪标签和统一的评估协议，实现实时且对齐的响应。与传统的级联模型不同，Motion-Omni允许语音生成模型直接输出面部表情和身体动作，从而实现更好的同步。该框架通过联合训练，确保语音和动作之间的对齐，同时保持对话能力。

papers.title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos
papers.abstract: Abstract Adapting a single-object 3D generative prior to multi-view observations enables scalable compositional mesh reconstruction of densely cluttered scenes with severe occlusion.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We study the problem of generating a compositional 3D representation of a cluttered scene containing hundreds of objects. The goal is to represent the scene as a collection of individual object meshes placed in a shared world frame, as required by downstream applications such as gaming, AR/VR, simulation, and robotics. This task is challenging in densely cluttered scenes, where objects heavily occlude one another and each view reveals only a fraction of their geometry. Geometry-based approaches typically reconstruct the scene as a single representation and leave incomplete geometry in occluded regions, while existing compositional methods with generative priors are largely limited to relatively simple scenes. We show that complex scenes with hundreds of objects can instead be generated compositionally by adapting a strong single-object 3D generative prior to multi-view observations. We instantiate this paradigm with Pixal3D, extending it with a multi-view conditioning pathway that grounds object generation in multiple posed observations. Although the model is finetuned entirely on single objects in canonical space, it generalizes to large scenes with severe occlusion without any scene-level training, demonstrating the feasibility and scalability of this paradigm. We further introduce UE-MeshyScene, a photorealistic benchmark of densely cluttered scenes with hundreds of objects, per-object annotations, and ground-truth meshes. Across single-object, controlled multi-object, and UE-MeshyScene evaluations, our method consistently outperforms prior approaches, with larger gains as scene complexity and occlusion increase. Finally, we demonstrate broader applicability by converting generated 3DGS worlds, such as Marble and HY-World 2.0, into compositional mesh scenes.

ru.title: Композиционная реконструкция загромождённых сцен через адаптацию генеративного прайора
ru.desc: В работе предлагается метод адаптации единого трёхмерного генеративного прайора для реконструкции композиционных сцен с сотнями объектов из многовидовых наблюдений. Ключевая идея заключается в том, что модель, обученная только на одиночных объектах в канонической системе координат, может обобщаться на сложные сцены с сильной окклюзией без обучения на уровне сцены. Авторы расширяют модель Pixal3D многовидовым кондиционированием и представляют новый фотореалистичный бенчмарк UE-MeshyScene с плотно упакованными сотнями объектов. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что предложенный подход последовательно превосходит существующие методы, особенно при увеличении сложности сцены и уровня окклюзии.

en.title: Revolutionizing 3D Scene Reconstruction with Compositional Meshes
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenge of creating a detailed 3D representation of complex scenes filled with many objects that often block each other from view. It introduces a method that adapts a single-object 3D generative model to work with multiple views of a scene, allowing for the reconstruction of individual object meshes in a shared coordinate system. The approach, implemented in a system called Pixal3D, effectively handles severe occlusions and generates accurate representations without needing extensive training on complex scenes. The authors also present a new benchmark, UE-MeshyScene, to evaluate their method against existing techniques, showing significant improvements in performance as scene complexity increases.

zh.title: 适应多视角的三维生成模型，重建复杂场景
zh.desc: 本研究探讨了如何将单一物体的三维生成先验适应于多视角观察，以实现复杂场景的组合网格重建。我们的方法能够在物体严重遮挡的情况下，生成包含数百个物体的场景的三维表示。通过引入多视角条件路径，模型能够在多个视角下生成物体，尽管模型仅在单一物体上进行微调，但它在复杂场景中表现出良好的泛化能力。我们的实验表明，该方法在处理复杂场景时，性能优于现有方法，且在场景复杂度和遮挡程度增加时，效果提升更为显著。

papers.title: Ask Before You Optimize: Dynamic Pre-Formulation Clarification for Interactive Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract OR-Clarify benchmarks clarification before optimization modeling, and InterOPT guides agents to ask questions or stop based on missing formulation-critical details.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to formulate optimization models from natural-language problem descriptions, yet realistic operations research (OR) requests are often incomplete: missing objectives, constraints, or business rules can change the resulting mathematical program. Existing evaluations largely assume a complete specification and therefore overlook whether an agent knows when clarification is needed before modeling. We introduce OR-Clarify, a benchmark for pre-formulation clarification. Each task presents a partial public problem description, withholds structured hidden slots, and evaluates agents through bounded interaction with a simulated user. The benchmark supports both openended and choice-based clarification, and measures slot recovery, stopping behavior, silent assumptions, and interaction cost. We further propose Interactive Optimization (InterOPT), a two-stage framework that identifies unresolved formulation-critical gaps and uses them to guide whether to ask the next question or to stop. In our choice-based experiments, InterOPT substantially outperforms all baselines in exact slot recovery; in the open-ended setting, it remains competitive with strong prior methods. Together, OR-Clarify and InterOPT reframe OR assistance as a selective completeness decision: clarify when needed, stop when ready, and quantify what remains missing.

ru.title: Задавай вопросы до моделирования: как научить LLM просить уточнения в задачах оптимизации
ru.desc: В работе предлагается набор данных OR-Clarify для оценки способности языковых моделей определять, когда им не хватает информации перед построением оптимизационной модели. Авторы показывают, что реальные задачи операционных исследований часто содержат неполные описания, где отсутствуют ограничения, целевые функции или деловые правила, что влияет на результирующую математическую программу. Они предлагают фреймворк InterOPT с двухэтапным подходом, который выявляет критические пробелы в формулировке и решает, нужно ли задавать следующий вопрос или остановиться. Работа переформулирует задачу оказания помощи в операционных исследованиях как стратегическое решение: уточнять необходимую информацию, завершать диалог вовремя и количественно измерять оставшиеся неопределённости.

en.title: Clarifying Gaps for Better Optimization Modeling
en.desc: This paper introduces OR-Clarify, a benchmark designed to assess how well agents can identify when they need more information before creating optimization models from incomplete problem descriptions. It highlights the importance of recognizing gaps in objectives, constraints, or business rules that can affect the final mathematical formulation. The authors also present InterOPT, a framework that helps agents decide whether to ask for clarification or proceed with modeling based on the identified gaps. Through experiments, InterOPT shows significant improvements in recovering missing information compared to existing methods, emphasizing the need for effective communication in operations research tasks.

zh.title: 优化建模前的智能澄清与决策
zh.desc: 这篇论文介绍了OR-Clarify和InterOPT两个工具，旨在帮助机器学习模型在优化建模之前进行必要的澄清。OR-Clarify是一个基准测试，评估模型在面对不完整问题描述时的澄清能力。InterOPT则是一个两阶段框架，帮助模型识别未解决的关键细节，并决定是否需要进一步提问或停止建模。通过这些方法，研究者希望提高模型在处理实际操作研究请求时的准确性和效率。

papers.title: Don't Drop Dropout: Optimizing Layer Sparsity for Efficient LLM Training and Inference
papers.abstract: Abstract Layer dropout improves large language model training efficiency and enables faster inference via early exit and speculative decoding without sacrificing accuracy.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Layer dropout (a.k.a. stochastic depth) has been shown to enable faster training, higher accuracy, and robustness to zero-shot layer pruning in both language and vision transformers. However, as models and datasets have scaled, dropout - particularly layer dropout - has largely disappeared from large language models (LLMs) pre-training recipes. While some prior work has reported that dropout can degrade accuracy, no comprehensive study has quantified, let alone mitigated, this effect. In this study, we show that layer dropout should be used in state-of-the-art LLM training, establishing best practices and scaling analysis for both training and post-training benefits. Concretely, with optimal layer distribution, time schedule, and optimizer hyperparameters, we observe that at the same training FLOPs layer dropout leads to lower loss. For a given number of training steps, LLMs can achieve lower or similar validation loss while saving upto 25% of training FLOPs. Moreover, layer dropout enables significant post-training optimizations, such as early exit, intermediate-layer skipping, and self-speculative decoding, yielding up to 1.5x inference speedup with negligible accuracy loss. Across more than 2400 training experiments, spanning models from 271M to 8.2B parameters and datasets up to 160B tokens, we demonstrate that these findings extend reliably to large-scale training regimes. All pre-training experiments were run on Cerebras CS-3 systems.

ru.title: Layer dropout: экономия вычислений без потери качества больших языковых моделей
ru.desc: В статье исследуется применение layer dropout (стохастической глубины) при обучении больших языковых моделей, которая была забыта в современных рецептах pre-training. Авторы показывают, что при оптимальном распределении layer dropout, расписании обучения и гиперпараметрах оптимизатора можно достичь нижней величины потерь при одинаковом количестве операций, сэкономив до 25% вычислительных ресурсов. Layer dropout также позволяет применять эффективные техники инференса: early exit, пропуск промежуточных слоёв и self-speculative decoding, ускоряя инференс в 1.5 раза без значительной потери точности. Результаты подтверждены на более чем 2400 экспериментах с моделями от 271M до 8.2B параметров и датасетами до 160B токенов.

en.title: Boosting LLM Efficiency with Layer Dropout
en.desc: This paper discusses the benefits of using layer dropout in training large language models (LLMs). Layer dropout, also known as stochastic depth, can enhance training efficiency and improve model accuracy while reducing the computational resources needed. The authors provide evidence that implementing layer dropout allows for faster inference through techniques like early exit and speculative decoding, without compromising accuracy. Their extensive experiments show that with the right configurations, layer dropout can lead to lower validation loss and significant savings in training time and resources.

zh.title: 层丢弃：提升大型语言模型训练效率的关键
zh.desc: 本研究探讨了层丢弃（layer dropout）在大型语言模型（LLM）训练中的重要性。通过优化层分布、时间调度和优化器超参数，层丢弃可以在相同的训练计算量下降低损失，并节省多达25%的训练资源。研究表明，层丢弃不仅提高了训练效率，还支持早期退出和自我推测解码等后训练优化，显著加快推理速度。我们的实验覆盖了从271M到8.2B参数的模型和高达160B标记的数据集，结果表明这些发现适用于大规模训练。

papers.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Abstract RISE improves language model post-training by recursively generating dense token-level supervision from the model's own reinforcement learning trajectory via self-extrapolation, avoiding external teachers.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense, per-token supervision for language model post-training, but its effectiveness is bottlenecked by teacher quality: external teachers suffer from distribution mismatch, while self-distillation with privileged conditioning is limited by in-context learning capacity. We propose RISE (Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation), which constructs a synthetic teacher directly from the model's own RLVR training trajectory. By extrapolating the displacement between the current checkpoint and a trailing anchor---in parameter space or output logit space---RISE converts a sparse outcome-induced parameter update into a dense token-level target, without any external model or privileged conditioning. RISE combines RLVR and OPD in a complementary loop: outcome rewards ground the extrapolation toward correct reasoning, while the extrapolated teacher refines token-level decisions. Moreover, since the teacher is refreshed every iteration as the student improves, distillation becomes a recursive improvement mechanism rather than a one-shot compression step. Experiments spanning mathematical reasoning, multi-domain STEM, code generation, and multi-turn agentic tasks show that RISE outperforms RLVR-only training and on-policy self-distillation across all settings.

ru.title: Самосовершенствование языковой модели через рекурсивную самодистилляцию
ru.desc: В работе предлагается RISE — метод улучшения языковых моделей, который использует самодистилляцию на основе собственной траектории обучения с подкреплением. Вместо внешних учителей модель генерирует плотное токен-уровневое supervision путём экстраполяции изменений параметров между текущей версией и предыдущей контрольной точкой. Метод объединяет обучение с подкреплением и дистилляцию в рекурсивный цикл, где награды за результаты направляют улучшение логики, а синтетический учитель уточняет решения на уровне токенов. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что RISE превосходит как обучение только с подкреплением, так и существующие методы self-distillation во всех задачах от математического рассуждения до написания кода.

en.title: Self-Improving Language Models with RISE
en.desc: RISE (Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation) enhances language model training by generating its own supervision from its reinforcement learning trajectory. This method avoids reliance on external teachers, which often face issues like distribution mismatch. By using self-extrapolation, RISE transforms sparse updates into dense, token-level targets, allowing for more effective learning. The approach creates a continuous feedback loop where the model improves iteratively, leading to better performance in various tasks such as mathematical reasoning and code generation.

zh.title: 自我外推，提升语言模型的智能！
zh.desc: RISE（递归改进通过自我外推策略蒸馏）是一种改进语言模型后训练的方法。它通过模型自身的强化学习轨迹生成密集的标记级监督，避免了使用外部教师。RISE通过在参数空间或输出对数空间中外推当前检查点与滞后锚点之间的位移，将稀疏的结果诱导参数更新转化为密集的标记级目标。实验表明，RISE在数学推理、多领域STEM、代码生成和多轮代理任务中均优于仅使用RLVR训练和基于策略的自我蒸馏。

papers.title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
papers.abstract: Abstract MaxKernel is a multi-agent system that automates TPU kernel development through collaborative, autonomous, and graph-based search paradigms, achieving expert-level performance on diverse benchmarks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Designing and authoring high-performance custom kernels for accelerators is a complex task that requires deep hardware-level expertise. Large Language Models (LLM) can be leveraged together with real-time compiler feedback to build agentic systems for kernel generation. In this work, we present MaxKernel, a multi-agent system that implements three distinct paradigms for TPU kernel development: (1) a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) agent for collaborative, step-by-step design; (2) an Autonomous (Auto) agent that executes a fully automated, metric/trace-driven optimization loop; and (3) a Graph-Based Autonomous Search that scales the Auto agent for global exploration of the design space. All three paradigms leverage a shared pool of specialized sub-agents to handle planning, implementation, self-debugging, testing, and hardware profiling. We evaluate MaxKernel on JaxBench, a comprehensive suite of 50 diverse kernel tasks for TPUs, alongside complex, real-world workloads from state-of-the-art open-source models. We demonstrate that MaxKernel consistently generates highly optimized implementations, matching expert hand-tuned baselines and delivering significant performance across the benchmark. Our agent is open-sourced and available https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/accelerator-agents/tree/main/MaxKernel.

ru.title: Автоматическая оптимизация ядер ускорителей через мультиагентный поиск
ru.desc: MaxKernel — это мультиагентная система, которая автоматизирует разработку TPU-ядер, используя три парадигмы поиска: совместную разработку с участием человека, полностью автономную оптимизацию и графо-ориентированный поиск по пространству конструкций. Система использует LLM вместе с обратной связью от компилятора в реальном времени, а также специализированные подагенты для планирования, имплементации, отладки и профилирования оборудования. Модель была протестирована на наборе JaxBench, содержащем 50 разнообразных задач оптимизации ядер для TPU, и продемонстрировала производительность, соответствующую экспертным решениям. Система способна масштабироваться для глобального исследования пространства параметров при разработке высокопроизводительных ядер для ускорителей.

en.title: Automating TPU Kernel Development with MaxKernel
en.desc: MaxKernel is a multi-agent system designed to automate the development of TPU kernels using collaborative and autonomous methods. It incorporates three main approaches: a Human-in-the-Loop agent for guided design, an Autonomous agent for automated optimization, and a Graph-Based Search for exploring the design space. By utilizing large language models and real-time compiler feedback, MaxKernel achieves expert-level performance on various benchmarks. The system is evaluated on JaxBench and demonstrates the ability to generate highly optimized kernel implementations that rival those created by human experts.

zh.title: MaxKernel：自动化TPU内核开发的智能系统
zh.desc: MaxKernel是一个多智能体系统，旨在通过协作、自主和基于图的搜索方法自动化TPU内核开发。该系统结合了大型语言模型（LLM）和实时编译器反馈，能够生成高性能的自定义内核。MaxKernel实现了三种不同的TPU内核开发范式，包括人机协作、完全自动化的优化循环和基于图的自主搜索。通过在JaxBench上进行评估，MaxKernel展示了其生成的实现与专家手动调优的基线相匹配，并在基准测试中提供了显著的性能提升。

papers.title: Enoki: Efficient Multi-Level Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract: Abstract Enoki is an open information extraction framework that unifies claim-level verification and span-level hallucination localization through shared relational facts, reducing resource use while improving detection accuracy.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Ensuring factuality remains a critical challenge for deploying LLMs in high-stakes settings. Existing hallucination detectors usually operate at a single level: claim-level methods provide interpretable factual units, while span-level methods localize unsupported text. Bridging these views is costly, as LLM-heavy pipelines require multiple decomposition and verification calls, and modular systems need additional claim-to-span alignment. We propose Enoki, an Open Information Extraction framework for multi-level hallucination detection. Enoki extracts text-anchored relational facts, verifies them against evidence, and projects unsupported facts back to hallucinated spans. This shared representation enables claim-level verification and span-level localization without requiring separate alignment. Enoki supports LLM-based, encoder-based, and rule-based extraction regimes, balancing accuracy and inference cost through a common interface. Experiments show that Enoki remains competitive with strong claim-level systems while using fewer resources and achieves superior performance on fine-grained span- and entity-level localization. We also release EnokiQA, a dual-granularity dataset with aligned claim-level verification and span-level localization annotations.

ru.title: Единое представление для верификации фактов на разных уровнях детализации
ru.desc: Enoki — это фреймворк открытой информационной экстракции, который объединяет проверку фактов на уровне утверждений и локализацию галлюцинаций на уровне фрагментов текста через единое представление релационных фактов. Система извлекает из текста якорированные релационные факты, проверяет их против источников и проецирует неподтвержденные факты обратно на галлюцинативные фрагменты. Фреймворк поддерживает различные режимы извлечения фактов — на основе LLM, энкодеров и правил — позволяя найти оптимальный баланс между точностью и вычислительными затратами. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что Enoki достигает конкурентной производительности при использовании меньше ресурсов и превосходит существующие методы при локализации галлюцинаций на уровне фрагментов и сущностей.

en.title: Unifying Claim Verification and Span Localization with Enoki
en.desc: Enoki is a framework designed for open information extraction that enhances the detection of inaccuracies in language models by integrating claim-level verification with span-level hallucination localization. It simplifies the process by using shared relational facts, which reduces the need for multiple verification steps and resource consumption. This approach allows for efficient extraction and verification of factual information, ensuring that unsupported claims can be traced back to their misleading text spans. Enoki also introduces a new dataset, EnokiQA, which provides aligned annotations for both claim-level and span-level tasks, improving the overall accuracy of hallucination detection.

zh.title: Enoki：统一幻觉检测的开放框架
zh.desc: Enoki是一个开放的信息提取框架，旨在通过共享关系事实来统一声明级验证和跨度级幻觉定位，从而减少资源使用并提高检测准确性。确保事实性在高风险环境中部署大型语言模型（LLMs）时仍然是一个关键挑战。Enoki提取文本锚定的关系事实，并将其与证据进行验证，同时将不支持的事实投影回幻觉跨度。通过这种共享表示，Enoki实现了声明级验证和跨度级定位，而无需单独的对齐过程。

papers.title: Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract GAPO adaptively adjusts importance-sampling clipping thresholds based on rollout advantage to preserve stronger gradient signals from low-success groups in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Group relative policy optimization for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically uses a fixed importance-sampling (IS) ratio clipping boundary across all rollouts. We identify a key limitation: rare correct rollouts on harder problems and abundant correct rollouts on easier problems are clipped at comparable rates, despite contributing very different learning signals. Rollouts with low group success exhibit larger IS ratios and carry stronger gradient signal for exploration and solving new problems, yet are disproportionately suppressed by fixed clipping.   To address this, we propose Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization (GAPO), a plug-in modification to GRPO methods that adapts the clipping boundary to the rollout advantage. GAPO is motivated by a reverse-KL trust-region perspective, which suggests that rollouts with larger learning signal should receive proportionally greater update headroom. GAPO requires no reward shaping and preserves the standard PPO/GSPO surrogate while adapting only the clipping threshold. Across Qwen and Llama models, GAPO consistently improves both Pass@1 and Pass@k over fixed clipping and advantage-shaping baselines on math reasoning and coding benchmarks where the pass rates by the base model are relatively low.

ru.title: Адаптивное отсечение для усиления обучения редких успехов
ru.desc: Статья представляет GAPO — адаптивный метод для оптимизации политики в обучении с подкреплением, который динамически подстраивает пороги отсечения важностного взвешивания в зависимости от преимущества траектории. Авторы выявили проблему: при использовании фиксированных порогов отсечения редкие успешные примеры на сложных задачах и частые успехи на простых задачах подавляются одинаково, хотя несут очень разные сигналы обучения. GAPO предлагает адаптировать граничное значение отсечения к групповому преимуществу, что позволяет сохранить более сильные градиенты от примеров с низкой вероятностью успеха, которые содержат больше информации для исследования и решения новых задач. Метод не требует переформирования награды и демонстрирует улучшения на задачах математического рассуждения и программирования для моделей Qwen и Llama.

en.title: Enhancing Learning Signals with Adaptive Clipping in Reinforcement Learning
en.desc: The paper introduces Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization (GAPO), a method that improves reinforcement learning by adjusting the importance-sampling clipping thresholds based on the advantage of rollouts. Traditional methods use a fixed clipping boundary, which can hinder learning from rare but informative rollouts, especially in challenging tasks. GAPO allows rollouts with lower success rates, which often carry stronger learning signals, to have more influence on the training process. This approach enhances performance on benchmarks by ensuring that valuable learning opportunities are not suppressed, leading to better outcomes in tasks like math reasoning and coding.

zh.title: 自适应剪切优化，提升强化学习效果
zh.desc: GAPO是一种自适应调整重要性采样剪切阈值的方法，旨在强化学习中保留来自低成功组的强梯度信号。传统的相对策略优化方法使用固定的剪切边界，导致在困难问题上稀有的正确回合和简单问题上丰富的正确回合被以相似的速率剪切。GAPO通过根据回合优势调整剪切边界，确保具有更大学习信号的回合获得更多的更新空间。实验结果表明，GAPO在数学推理和编码基准测试中，相较于固定剪切和优势塑形基线，显著提高了模型的通过率。

papers.title: When Models Edit Too Much: On the Fidelity of Minimal Code Edits
papers.abstract: Abstract Large language models frequently over-edit code during repair, but preservation instructions and reinforcement learning can improve edit fidelity without sacrificing correctness.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to edit existing code, but correctness alone is not enough: useful repairs should also be minimal, reviewable, and faithful to the original implementation. We study over-editing, the tendency of a model to rewrite code beyond what is required to fix a bug. We construct an evaluation framework from 400 BigCodeBench problems by injecting controlled AST-level corruptions into reference solutions, giving each repair task a known minimal patch. Across frontier LLMs, over-editing is widespread even among strong models like GPT-5.5: high Pass@1 can coexist with unnecessarily large edits and added cognitive complexity. A preservation instruction substantially reduces this behavior, lowering average excess Levenshtein distance from 0.195 to 0.131, reducing added cognitive complexity by 26.6%, and increasing Pass@1 by 2.3 points. However, these gains do not simply follow from a larger reasoning budget or larger models. We next ask whether minimal editing can be learned directly during post-training. We observe that supervised fine-tuning overfits to seen corruption patterns, whereas reinforcement learning gives the best out-of-domain edit-fidelity and performance-retention trade-off. These results position edit fidelity as a distinct axis of code-repair quality and show that it can be measured and learned.

ru.title: Обучение точному редактированию кода: баланс между исправлением и минимальностью
ru.desc: В работе исследуется проблема избыточного редактирования кода языковыми моделями при исправлении ошибок, когда модель переписывает больше кода, чем необходимо. Авторы создали оценочный фреймворк на основе 400 задач BigCodeBench с контролируемыми повреждениями синтаксического дерева для оценки минимальности исправлений. Показано, что инструкции по сохранению исходного кода значительно снижают избыточное редактирование и повышают качество, однако это улучшение не просто следует из увеличения вычислительных ресурсов или размера модели. Авторы демонстрируют, что минимальное редактирование может быть обучено на этапе fine-tuning с помощью reinforcement learning, который обеспечивает лучший баланс между точностью редактирования вне области обучения и сохранением производительности.

en.title: Enhancing Code Repair: Minimizing Over-Editing in LLMs
en.desc: This paper addresses the issue of over-editing in large language models (LLMs) when they repair code, which can lead to unnecessary changes that complicate understanding. The authors propose using preservation instructions and reinforcement learning to enhance the fidelity of edits while maintaining correctness. They develop an evaluation framework using 400 BigCodeBench problems to analyze the extent of over-editing across various LLMs, revealing that even advanced models like GPT-5.5 struggle with this issue. The findings suggest that edit fidelity is a crucial aspect of code repair quality that can be effectively measured and improved through specific training techniques.

zh.title: 提升代码修复质量，减少过度编辑
zh.desc: 大型语言模型在修复代码时常常会过度编辑，但通过保留指令和强化学习可以提高编辑的准确性而不影响正确性。我们研究了过度编辑现象，即模型在修复错误时重写代码超出必要范围的倾向。通过构建一个评估框架，我们发现即使是强大的模型如GPT-5.5也普遍存在过度编辑的问题。我们的研究表明，保留指令和强化学习可以有效改善编辑的保真度，从而提升代码修复的质量。

papers.title: τ^τ-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction
papers.abstract: Abstract The τ^τ-bench benchmark evaluates coding agents on building real-world customer-service agents from business records, client requirements, and production APIs, revealing substantial gaps versus expert performance.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small LLM agents are rapidly becoming production software, deployed to handle customer service, adjudicate disputes, and operate internal systems. Notably, the work of building them is increasingly handed to coding agents, yet existing benchmarks say little about whether an AI system can deliver one under the conditions of a real client engagement. We introduce τ^τ-bench (pronounced hyper-tau-bench), a benchmark that makes agent construction the task. A developer agent is given the records a business actually keeps, a client who holds requirements, a production API that operations must run through, a codebase to inherit, and limits on serving cost and models: the same starting point a real engagement provides. From these it must deliver a complete customer-service agent, scored by deploying that agent against held-out simulated users. Across 53 tasks spanning four domains, the strongest configuration, Claude Opus 5 under Claude Code, passes just 23.9% of evaluation simulations. Meanwhile, an expert-authored reference ceiling scores 82.2%. The failures mirror ones human agent developers see: models issue shallow queries in place of deep comprehension of the records, communicate almost nothing to the client, and experiment too little with agent architecture and serving spend, shipping the first design that runs. We aim for τ^τ-bench to turn the work of cooperative agent building into a measurable target for coding agents.

ru.title: Измерение способности AI-агентов разрабатывать production-системы обслуживания клиентов
ru.desc: В статье представлен бенчмарк τ^τ-bench для оценки способности кодирующих агентов строить полнофункциональные системы обслуживания клиентов на основе реальных бизнес-данных, требований клиентов и production API. Агенты должны разработать готовое решение, начиная с тех же условий, что и в реальных проектах, включая ограничения на стоимость обслуживания и выбор моделей. Результаты показывают значительный разрыв между лучшей моделью (Claude Opus достигает 23.9% успеха) и экспертным решением (82.2%), причем ошибки агентов отражают типичные проблемы разработчиков: поверхностные запросы к данным, плохая коммуникация с клиентом и недостаточная экспериментация с архитектурой. Бенчмарк содержит 53 задачи из четырех предметных областей и направлен на превращение задачи кооперативного построения агентов в измеримую цель для кодирующих систем.

en.title: Bridging the Gap: Evaluating AI in Real-World Customer Service Agent Development
en.desc: The τ^τ-bench benchmark assesses the ability of coding agents to create effective customer-service agents using real business data and client requirements. It highlights significant performance gaps between AI-generated agents and those developed by human experts. The benchmark involves a developer agent that must construct a complete customer-service solution while adhering to real-world constraints, such as cost and operational APIs. Results show that even the best AI configurations struggle to meet expert standards, indicating a need for improved understanding and design in AI agent development.

zh.title: 提升编码代理构建能力的基准测试
zh.desc: τ^τ-bench基准测试评估编码代理在构建真实世界客户服务代理方面的能力，显示出与专家表现之间的显著差距。该基准测试要求开发者代理在真实的客户需求和业务记录的基础上，构建完整的客户服务代理，并通过模拟用户进行评估。研究发现，当前的编码代理在理解记录和与客户沟通方面存在不足，且在代理架构和成本控制上缺乏实验。我们的目标是将合作代理构建的工作转变为编码代理可衡量的目标。

papers.title: When Quantization Breaks Memory: Recurrent-State Write-Back in Low-Precision Temporal Inference
papers.abstract: Abstract Quantized recurrent inference suffers from state write-back rules that suppress small updates, but error feedback and residual memory restore accuracy without retraining across GRU and LSTM architectures.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Quantization is widely used to reduce the computational and memory demands of neural-network inference. In recurrent networks, however, the quantized state is stored and returned at the next time step, so the rule used to store that state can alter subsequent computations. Here, we introduce recurrent-state write-back to denote this rule and isolate its effect in a compact GRU encoder--decoder for fluorescence lifetime imaging, a molecular imaging modality used in quantitative biological imaging. A central task is estimating two lifetime parameters, the short-lived component τ1 and the long-lived component τ2, from high-noise time-resolved fluorescence signals. Holding the trained model fixed, replacing continuous state propagation with deterministic 4-bit state storage increases estimation errors for τ1 and τ2 by approximately 70x and 300x, respectively. Failure occurs when repeated small updates remain below the write threshold, leaving the stored state nearly fixed while the network continues to propose change. Error feedback, residual memory, and direction memory carry information from these suppressed updates across time and recover accuracy without retraining. Precision sweeps show that increasing state precision can worsen a fixed recurrent solution, while matched training shows that compatibility with the state interface can be learned. To test whether this behavior extends beyond the GRU, we repeat the post-training intervention in an independently trained LSTM, where coarse write-back reproduces the failure, error feedback restores accuracy, and state-specific interventions reveal greater sensitivity of the cell state than the hidden state. Our results establish recurrent-state write-back as a key determinant of low-precision recurrent dynamics and identify the state-storage interface as a central design consideration for quantized recurrent inference.
affiliations: Department of Biomedical Engineering, Center for Modeling, Simulation, and Imaging in Medicine, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Troy, NY 12180

ru.title: Обратная связь ошибки спасает квантованные рекуррентные сети
ru.desc: В этой работе исследуется проблема квантизации рекуррентных нейронных сетей, которая приводит к значительным ошибкам при сохранении состояния в низкой точности. Авторы вводят концепцию «write-back правила» для состояния и показывают, что оно критически влияет на точность вывода в архитектурах GRU и LSTM. Они предлагают использовать error feedback и residual memory для восстановления точности без переобучения модели, демонстрируя это на задаче флуоресцентной спектроскопии. Результаты показывают, что правильная организация интерфейса хранения состояния является ключевым фактором для успешной квантизации рекуррентных сетей.

en.title: Unlocking Accuracy in Quantized Recurrent Networks
en.desc: This paper discusses the challenges of using quantized recurrent neural networks, specifically focusing on how state write-back rules can hinder small updates in GRU and LSTM architectures. The authors introduce the concept of recurrent-state write-back, which affects the accuracy of estimating parameters in fluorescence lifetime imaging. They demonstrate that using low-precision state storage can significantly increase estimation errors, but techniques like error feedback and residual memory can help recover accuracy without retraining the model. The findings highlight the importance of the state-storage interface in designing effective quantized recurrent inference systems.

zh.title: 量化递归推理中的状态写回关键性
zh.desc: 量化递归推理在状态写回规则上存在问题，这会抑制小的更新。通过错误反馈和残余记忆，可以在不重新训练的情况下恢复GRU和LSTM架构的准确性。我们提出了递归状态写回的概念，并在荧光寿命成像的紧凑GRU编码器-解码器中分析其影响。研究表明，状态存储接口是量化递归推理设计中的一个重要考虑因素。

papers.title: AdaptVPR: Route-Aware Hard Positive Generation for Robust Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract: Abstract AdaptVPR improves visual place recognition by generating verified synthetic same-place images with diverse appearance changes to train more robust models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Visual Place Recognition (VPR) localizes a query image by retrieving database images of the same or nearby place, yet its robustness is often degraded by domain shifts arising from illumination, weather, seasonal changes, and dynamic occlusions. One contributing factor is the limited appearance diversity of the same place in existing training data. To address this issue, we propose AdaptVPR, a route-aware generative augmentation framework that constructs same-place hard positives for robust VPR training. AdaptVPR first uses a vision language model to parse scene attributes and estimate editing feasibility, while a rule-based scheduler determines the generation route according to editability scores and risk constraints. The generation process is decomposed into three complementary routes: the Global Appearance Route introduces global scene changes in weather, illumination, and time of day; the Local Occlusion Route inserts plausible dynamic occluders; and the Dual Route combines both types of perturbations to produce more challenging appearance shifts. Each generated candidate is evaluated using a VPR-oriented verification scheme based on geometric consistency and appearance diversity, reducing the risk of structural drift while ensuring sufficient appearance variation. Global candidates are generated once and rejected if verification fails, while Local Occlusion and Dual candidates use verification feedback for limited prompt refinement and regeneration. Using this framework, we construct AdaptCities, containing 160K verified synthetic same-place hard positives. Experiments across multiple VPR baselines and vision foundation backbones show consistent gains on standard benchmarks and substantial improvements under challenging domain shifts, with R@1 gains of up to 9.2%. The source code and data resources are publicly available at https://github.com/chenshunpeng/AdaptVPR.

ru.title: Синтетическое увеличение данных для устойчивого распознавания мест
ru.desc: AdaptVPR — это новая система для распознавания мест на изображениях, которая использует генеративные модели для создания синтетических данных с разными условиями освещения, погоды и времени суток. Фреймворк применяет видео-языковые модели для анализа сцен и генерирует сложные позитивные примеры через три маршрута: глобальные изменения внешнего вида, локальные окклюзии и комбинированные возмущения. Каждый сгенерированный кандидат проверяется с помощью верификационной схемы на основе геометрической консистентности и разнообразия внешнего вида, чтобы избежать структурных деградаций. Метод показывает устойчивые улучшения на стандартных бенчмарках и достигает прироста метрики R@1 до 9.2% в условиях экстремальных сдвигов в доменах.

en.title: Enhancing Place Recognition with Diverse Synthetic Images
en.desc: AdaptVPR enhances visual place recognition by creating verified synthetic images that show the same location under various conditions. This approach addresses the problem of limited diversity in training data, which can weaken model performance due to changes in lighting, weather, and other factors. The framework uses a vision language model to assess scene attributes and employs a rule-based scheduler to guide the generation of images through different routes, ensuring a wide range of appearance variations. By generating a large dataset of 160K synthetic images, AdaptVPR significantly improves the robustness of VPR models against domain shifts, achieving notable performance gains in standard benchmarks.

zh.title: 通过合成图像提升视觉地点识别的鲁棒性
zh.desc: AdaptVPR通过生成经过验证的合成同地点图像，改善了视觉地点识别的效果。这些合成图像具有多样的外观变化，帮助训练更强大的模型。该方法使用视觉语言模型解析场景属性，并通过规则调度器确定生成路线，以应对不同的编辑需求。最终，AdaptVPR构建了一个包含16万张经过验证的合成同地点图像的数据集，显著提高了在各种挑战性领域转移下的识别性能。

papers.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract ShallowStream uses shallow MLLM layers to build a lightweight streaming index, reducing latency while maintaining accurate video retrieval.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Streaming video understanding is a critical capability for real-world applications, including embodied intelligence, autonomous driving, industrial monitoring, surveillance and early warning, and wearable assistants. However, processing continuous video streams with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is computationally expensive. Existing efforts have explored reducing streaming overhead through visual token pruning, token merging, quantization, on-demand frame retrieval, and context offloading. However, most existing methods overlook the dimension of model depth. Repeatedly executing full-depth MLLM prefill over incoming frames is prohibitively expensive, incurring substantial computational overhead and causing the KV cache to grow at a rate directly proportional to the prefill depth. To address these challenges, we propose ShallowStream, a novel framework that leverages the shallow layers of an MLLM to simultaneously perform frame encoding and retrieval index building. During stream processing, ShallowStream maintains an always-on lightweight index using the KV cache of shallow layers. During query-time answering, we leverage the attention scores generated by the shallow layers to score context frames and employ a diversity-aware selection strategy to retrieve precise and comprehensive evidence. ShallowStream achieves performance on par with the strongest existing streaming methods, while reducing per-frame prefill latency and 10-second end-to-end latency by up to 52.1x and 11.9x, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/CURRENTF/ShallowStream.

ru.title: Быстрое понимание видеопотоков через использование поверхностных слоёв MLLM
ru.desc: ShallowStream — это фреймворк для эффективной обработки видеопотоков с использованием мультимодальных больших языковых моделей (MLLM). Вместо использования полной глубины модели для каждого кадра, метод применяет только поверхностные слои нейросети для одновременного кодирования видеокадров и построения лёгкого индекса поиска. Система хранит KV-кеш поверхностных слоёв и использует оценки внимания для выбора релевантных контекстных кадров с учётом их разнообразия. Решение достигает результатов, сравнимых с лучшими существующими методами, при этом снижая задержку обработки каждого кадра в 52 раза и общую задержку системы в 12 раз.

en.title: Streamline Video Retrieval with ShallowStream!
en.desc: ShallowStream is a new framework designed to improve the efficiency of video retrieval from continuous streams using shallow layers of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). By focusing on shallow layers, it reduces the computational burden associated with processing each video frame, which traditionally requires deep model execution. This approach allows for the creation of a lightweight streaming index that maintains accuracy while significantly lowering latency. ShallowStream demonstrates a remarkable reduction in both per-frame prefill latency and overall end-to-end latency, making it a powerful solution for real-time video understanding applications.

zh.title: 轻量级流媒体索引，快速视频检索！
zh.desc: ShallowStream 是一种新颖的框架，利用浅层多模态大语言模型（MLLM）来构建轻量级的流媒体索引，从而降低延迟并保持视频检索的准确性。该方法在处理连续视频流时，通过使用浅层的 KV 缓存来维持一个始终在线的轻量级索引。ShallowStream 在查询时利用浅层生成的注意力分数来评分上下文帧，并采用多样性感知选择策略来检索精确且全面的证据。与现有的流媒体方法相比，ShallowStream 在每帧预填充延迟和端到端延迟上分别减少了高达 52.1 倍和 11.9 倍，表现出色。

papers.title: To See a World in a Living Context: Unified Indoor-Outdoor Urban World Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract HoloWorld unifies indoor and outdoor 3D urban generation through a continuously updated cross-scale context that ensures coherent building-level correspondence and cross-block continuity.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Text-driven 3D generation has advanced rapidly in creating large-scale outdoor environments and detailed indoor scenes, but these domains are usually synthesized independently, lacking the correspondence required for a coherent urban world. We present HoloWorld, a unified indoor-outdoor urban world generation framework built on a continuously updated cross-scale world context. Initializing from a user description, HoloWorld progressively represents and updates the diverse world information, from city-scale planning to individual buildings, allowing generated interiors to maintain explicit correspondence with their associated exterior buildings. Conditioned on the evolving context and previously generated neighboring blocks, HoloWorld autoregressively generates urban exteriors with consistent spatial organization and visual identity across blocks. The generated exterior representations are further grounded in 3D building instances and footprints, enabling building-specific indoor generation with geometry-constrained layouts and inherited appearance characteristics. To our knowledge, HoloWorld is the first framework to unify indoor and outdoor generation within a coherent 3D urban world. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HoloWorld achieves superior urban exterior generation performance, improving the average AQS score over the SOTA by 7.68\% and obtaining the highest average RDR score, while maintaining strong building-level indoor-outdoor correspondence and cross-block continuity within a unified 3D urban world. Our project page: https://huangxb326.github.io/HoloWorld/.

ru.title: Единый генератор городов: от площади до комнат
ru.desc: HoloWorld представляет единую систему генерации трёхмерных городских сцен, которая объединяет внутренние и внешние пространства через иерархический контекст, обновляемый во время генерации. Фреймворк использует текстовое описание пользователя и прогрессивно синтезирует город от масштаба целого района до деталей отдельных зданий. Система генерирует внешние структуры зданий с согласованной пространственной организацией и визуальной идентичностью между соседними кварталами. Интерьеры зданий генерируются с явной геометрической привязкой и наследуют визуальные характеристики от экстерьеров, обеспечивая полную согласованность трёхмерного городского мира.

en.title: Unifying Indoor and Outdoor 3D Urban Generation with HoloWorld
en.desc: HoloWorld is a novel framework that integrates the generation of both indoor and outdoor 3D urban environments, ensuring that buildings and their surroundings are coherent and contextually relevant. It utilizes a continuously updated cross-scale context that allows for the dynamic representation of urban information, from city planning to individual structures. By initializing from user descriptions, HoloWorld generates urban exteriors and interiors that maintain a strong correspondence, ensuring that the design of indoor spaces reflects the characteristics of their outdoor counterparts. The framework has shown significant improvements in urban generation performance, surpassing state-of-the-art methods while maintaining continuity across different urban blocks.

zh.title: 统一室内外生成的3D城市框架
zh.desc: HoloWorld是一个统一的室内外3D城市生成框架，通过持续更新的跨尺度上下文，确保建筑级别的一致性和跨区块的连续性。该框架从用户描述初始化，逐步表示和更新城市规模到单个建筑的多样化信息，使生成的室内与外部建筑保持明确的对应关系。HoloWorld自回归地生成城市外观，确保跨区块的一致空间组织和视觉特征。实验结果表明，HoloWorld在城市外观生成性能上优于现有技术，显著提高了平均AQS分数，并在统一的3D城市世界中保持强大的建筑级室内外对应关系和跨区块连续性。
